name: web-neo-brutalist-tech-page-with-mint-yellow-orange-and-hard-shadows
title: Long neo-brutalist infrastructure site in mint, yellow, orange and black with monospace headings, hard-shadow cards and ticker
whatItIs: A tall page with a black-outlined nav, hero 'ENGINEERED FOR THE EXTREME' with an orange keyword and a mint panel with a tilted yellow square '0101', a black scrolling ticker, three hard-shadow spec cards, highlighted headings, orange and grey blocks, an orange stat strip, testimonial cards, three-tier pricing with a yellow middle plan, a mint email footer and a black footer.
whatItMeans: Loud and playful; hard shadows, bright fills and underscore headings feel like a developer zine.
techniques: Give every card a thick border and hard offset shadow.
Alternate mint, yellow and orange blocks.
Highlight the recommended plan in yellow.

vocabulary.definition: A solid unblurred shadow beside an element.
A heading with underscores between words.
Flat bright fills used as sections.
